implementation.minimization: SOP groups 2,3 and 3,7,11,15 using the allowed don't-cares. A product covering 2 needs at least three literals, and a product covering 15 needs at least two; no one product can cover both. POS groups zeros with don't-cares: all c=0 inputs, a=1/d=0 inputs, and b=1/d=0 inputs. Zeros 0,6,10 require distinct zero groups, with at least one, two, and two literals respectively. Both forms therefore use five literals with minimum term/clause counts.
